shorts.title: What you will learn: unordered_map
shorts.hook: The fastest way to look up a key.
shorts.script: The fastest way to look up a key. Today we meet the map that trades order for speed. It is the right tool for counting and for fast look-up. An unordered map uses a hash table. It finds a key in about one step, even when the map is big. The price is that the keys have no order. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: unordered_map.

shorts.title: unordered_map in one minute
shorts.hook: An unordered map uses a hash table.
shorts.script: An unordered map uses a hash table. It finds a key in about one step, even when the map is big. The price is that the keys have no order. It has the same functions as map. Use map when you need sorted keys. Use unordered map when you need speed. Think of a locker room. The key number takes you straight to the locker. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: unordered_map in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.script: The map holds two prices. Count returns one if the key exists. It returns zero if it does not. Find gives an iterator to the pair. The value is forty-five. Neither call changes the map. The program prints one, zero, and forty-five. An unordered map finds a key fast. The order of its keys is not defined. Use map when you need sorted keys. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: At with a missing key
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. We call at with a key that is not in the map. The program stops. It says terminate called after throwing an instance of out of range. At is the safe way, because it tells you about the problem. Check with count first. At checks the key, and it throws an exception when the key is missing. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: At with a missing key.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: The hash map said, I do not care about order. I only care that you find me fast.
shorts.script: The hash map said, I do not care about order. I only care that you find me fast. Count how often each letter appears in the word Konkani. Print the count of the letter n. Write your answer in the comments. An unordered map finds a key fast. The order of its keys is not defined. Use map when you need sorted keys. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
